name: hanging half windmill
description: From a hang you lift the legs and sweep them to one side in a half circle. It builds oblique strength and grip.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with a firm overhand grip.
Raise both legs together toward one side of the bar.
Sweep them across the front in a half circle.
Lower the legs on the other side under control.
Keep the swing small and your shoulders active.
